{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overconfidence in upward trends.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — if true outcome exceeds model by >5% in 3 consecutive days, apply a 10% upward bias correction for next period.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if model consistently overpredicts (forecast > true by >3% for 5+ days), reduce forecast by 1.5% per day until convergence.",
    "For sentiment = 0.00, use 30-day moving average of true outcomes as baseline, then add 0.5% volatility buffer if recent price is rising.",
    "If model forecast is below 60% of 30-day true mean, apply upward bias of 2% to avoid underestimating rebound potential.",
    "When sentiment = 1.00 (strong bullish), reduce forecast by 1% to avoid overreaction to short-term momentum.",
    "For high volatility (>10% daily range), apply smoothing filter: forecast = 0.8 * previous + 0.2 * current true value to dampen noise."
  ]
}
